unlocated_definition: games_universe_v2 is_d1_game; ours located = max(CBBD located share, hoopR located share) > 0.5 over FGA rows (results/coordinate_audit master tables); a universe game with no CBBD pbp rows counts as unlocated
gain_note: CBBD plays are on disk only from 2021-11 (season 2022), so for 2019-2021 the only on-disk coordinates are hoopR_hist pbp (ESPN, roughly 11-14% located); 'unlocated' there means hoopR_hist located share <= 0.5. CBBD coordinates for those seasons (sampled earlier at 28-71%) are not on disk, so the true gain over a full CBBD pull would be smaller.
